tasks.title: Science block: build ghosts x=9..56, y=-40..-26 (asms, inserters, poles, labs)
tasks.detail:
The ghosts are already placed. Build with build_ghosts. You need 12 assembling-machine-1, 4 lab, 24 inserter, 13 long-handed-inserter, 15 small-electric-pole. First mine the rocks at about (18.5,-38.5) and (19.5,-35.5).
ROW A, asm centers y=-28.5, iron from belt M at y=-25.5 via inserters at y=-26.5: gear 46.5 | inserter 42.5 | circuit 38.5 | cable 34.5. Direct insertion cable->circuit at (36.5,-28.5) and circuit->inserter at (40.5,-28.5).
Top inserter row y=-30.5: gear output onto B1 (46.5). Inserter asm takes gears from B1 (42.5). Cable asm takes copper from B1 (34.5). Long inserter (41.5) puts inserters onto B2.
ROW B, asm centers y=-35.5: green 38.5 | belt 34.5 | green 30.5 | belt 26.5 | green 22.5 | red 18.5 | red 14.5 | red 10.5. The belt asms feed greens directly via (36.5,-35.5), (32.5,-35.5) and (24.5,-35.5). Bottom row y=-33.5: normal inserters take from B2 (inserters + iron), long inserters take from B1 (gears + copper). Top row y=-37.5: red output goes to S1 (y=-38.5) with normal inserters; green output goes to S2 (y=-39.5) with long inserters.
LABS at y=-35.5, x=42.5/46.5/50.5/54.5. Each lab has a normal inserter (picks S1, red) and a long inserter (picks S2, green) at y=-37.5.
Get assemblers by picking up the old chest-fed asms (claude-2 green build, claude-3 gear/belt asms) and the 2 asm1 in chest (-13.5,-36.5). Move the 2 existing labs and craft 2 new ones. Set the recipes per ghost.
